message.content: This is my final review turn. The probes are decisive: the full kernel (fp16 cast included) achieves E = 3.22e-4 on the exact seed-815 workload, ~3x below the 0.001 budget, with outputs finite and the denominator well above the floor; the fp32 softmax path alone contributes only ~2.8e-7. Both in-scope claims (c1, c2) are rebutted by direct runtime evidence on the exact contract workload, and no uncovered attack surface exists for this single fixed workload. I'll record no new claims.
